query: WITH demographics_base AS (SELECT id, gender, head_of_household_id FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala WHERE person_status = 'صالح' AND death_date IS NULL), gender_totals AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_females, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_males FROM demographics_base), wealthy_counts AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wealthy_females, SUM(CASE WHEN d.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wealthy_males FROM demographics_base AS d JOIN estishraf_llm_wealth_index AS w ON d.head_of_household_id = w.head_of_household_id WHERE w.wealth_level = 'Rich') SELECT gt.total_females, gt.total_males, wc.wealthy_females, wc.wealthy_males, ROUND(wc.wealthy_females * 100.0 / gt.total_females, 2) AS wealthy_female_pct, ROUND(wc.wealthy_males * 100.0 / gt.total_males, 2) AS wealthy_male_pct FROM gender_totals AS gt CROSS JOIN wealthy_counts AS wc LIMIT 1200
